analyst_view.overall: Early view: Egnatia, who lead the Albanian league, drew their first two games (1-1 with Midtjylland and at AGF) and then lost 2-0 at Universitatea Craiova with ten men. Kauno Zalgiris are bottom with no points, one goal scored and eleven conceded. Egnatia need a win to stay in the race for the top 24.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals. I lean a little lower: Egnatia have scored two goals in three games and sat in a five-man defence at Craiova, and Kauno Zalgiris have scored once in three games. Kauno do leak goals (4-0 at Brighton, 1-4 v Brann, 3-0 at Lugano), so Egnatia should score, but not freely.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.8 corners, more for Egnatia at home. Nothing in the reports points away from that, so I stay with it.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.2 cards. Eneo Bitri was sent off at Craiova after reacting to provocation, and Kauno picked up two bookings at Lugano, so cards are a real feature, but the estimate already covers that. On Bitri: if it was a one-match ban he should serve it against Lincoln on 26 November, so he may be back here; that needs checking nearer the game.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.3 shots, with Egnatia on 16. Egnatia should have more of the ball at home than they did in Romania, and Kauno started brightly at Lugano before fading, so I stay with the estimate.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.9 shots on target. I found nothing that moves it either way, so the view rests on form here.
